reason_clay.owner_fixed_law: Each exact go macro-cycle includes exactly one bounded out-of-the-box experiment.
reason_clay.observed_ambiguity: Concurrent durable state contains more than one distinct artifact described as the one OOB experiment, while the relevant receipts do not share a machine-checkable root_go_id. Therefore current evidence cannot distinguish a same-root duplicate from separate concurrent root go cycles.

candidate_contract.root_go_id: required immutable identity minted once per user/root go invocation
candidate_contract.oob_slot: single atomic/CAS claim keyed by root_go_id
candidate_contract.recovery: abandoned lease may be reclaimed only by explicit expiry/recovery receipt; completed slot is immutable
candidate_contract.distributed_rule: child workers inherit root_go_id; they do not mint independent OOB allowance unless they are demonstrably a separate root invocation

payload.strongest_counterhypothesis: The two observed OOB labels may belong to genuinely separate root go invocations. Without root identity this cannot be adjudicated, which is why the proposed change is identity/coordination instrumentation rather than a claim that the scientific experiments were invalid.
payload.discriminating_test: Spawn two concurrent child workers under one synthetic root_go_id and prove exactly one CAS claim executes as OOB while the loser is fail-closed/reclassified; then run two distinct root_go_id values and prove both may independently claim one slot.
